data_fields.name: cycle_period
data_fields.donor_constant: 599 frames (run on request or after the period)

data_fields.name: tasks_per_requirement
data_fields.donor_constant: one task per unit of required quantity, per source and bucket

data_fields.name: nearest_match_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: max(|dx|, |dy|) + |dz| (a vertical level counts one step)

data_fields.name: finalize_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: sum of remaining required quantities is 0

data_fields.name: last_scan_sources
data_fields.donor_constant: BOULDER, WOOD, BAR, IN_PLAY (in that order, scanned after the rest)

data_fields.name: priority_move_depth
data_fields.donor_constant: one task per requirement and source moved to the front

best_idea: A planned building registers one task per unit of each required input, and each cycle attaches the nearest matching item to the first task in its FIFO, finalizing the building only when every input is delivered.
decision_why: The wait-for-inputs queue (nearest-first, FIFO per filter, priority move) suits a hub placed only after its inputs leave the one ledger, but the cycle becomes a server-tick budget and the failed-attach branch must make progress.
acceptance: A town hub appears in the zone only after its last required item leaves the one ledger; the server attaches the nearest item first, and a server test with a forced attach failure shows the queue drains without repeating the same item.
